{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_orders = data[qa_mask]

# Remove QA orders from the dataset
data_clean = data[~qa_mask]

# Verify that QA orders are removed
print("Number of QA orders removed:", len(qa_orders))
print("Number of rows in cleaned data:", len(data_clean))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = data_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
print("Number of refunded orders:", refunded_mask.sum())

# Remove refunded orders
data_final = data_clean[~refunded_mask]

# Final check: number of rows
print("Number of rows in final dataset:", len(data_final))"}
